text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, so what happened to that crying kid?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, she's lookin' suuuper down, so could 
ya go ask her if she's alright?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
She was totally bawling, saying she wasn't 
okay~! So I was like, we gotta hype her 
mood up big time. Let's get god-tier hyped 
at karaoke!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And then~, they went to the ocean and 
shouted, "You idiot!!" Said it felt sooo 
refreshing!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's our classic go-to spot! The 
place we always hit up to get hyped after 
losing a race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then that girl will definitely blow away 
all her doubts too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! She was teaching class with plenty 
of energy just a little while ago!
